messages:
Maya Li: ok team — quick sync: we need a crisp checklist to move pilot customers to GA. main buckets: SLA, docs, support/rotations, monitoring & alerting, pricing changes. who owns what?

Jonah Park: I can own runtime perf & canary plan. need clear latency SLOs and canary traffic %s.

Priya Singh: monitoring + alerting: we currently have infra + model health dashboards but no service-level SLO doc. propose: SLOs + alert playbook + error-budget policy.

Carlos Ruiz: support: we need a customer-facing triage guide, runbooks for the 3 most common issues (OOMs, model misbehavior, auth failures), and oncall rotations for the first 30d of GA.

Elena Fischer: pricing: pilot discounts end at GA. finance needs a migration plan for existing customers (prorated invoices + clear notice). also need a pricing FAQ in docs.

Maya Li: timeline: GA target = 3 weeks. list action owners + deliverables by EOD tomorrow. also we need to lock SLA number — any thoughts?

Jonah Park: proposed SLA: 99.9% for hosted inference (excludes scheduled maintenance). that maps to ~43.8m downtime/year. can we accept that?

Priya Singh: 99.9% is okay if we have canaries + automated fallback to smaller models. otherwise we should plan 99.95% (higher ops cost). recommend adding a fallback policy to SLA appendix.

Maya Li: quick strawman in channel:
```
SLA: 99.9% monthly availability for hosted inference endpoints. Exclusions: scheduled maintenance (>48h notice), force majeure, customer misconfiguration.
Remedies: credit-based, tiered by uptime band.
```

Carlos Ruiz: for support SLAs, propose: first response within 1h for P1, triage within 24h for feature requests, bug fix SLA TBD. shipping docs + runbooks needed before GA.

Elena Fischer: commercial note — any GA price bump needs 30d notice. ops/marketing must coordinate comms.

Jonah Park: perf testing plan: run 72h steady-state soak at 120% expected peak, and two 1h spike tests. will share scripts.

Priya Singh: monitoring checklist: 1) synthetic smoke every region 2) anomaly detection on latency and error-rate 3) dashboard + runbook links on oncall pager. I'll create alerts and link them to playbooks.

Maya Li: good. owners: Jonah = runtime & canary, Priya = monitoring/SLOs, Carlos = support/runbooks & ops playbook, Elena = pricing migration + comms. Maya = launch criteria doc owner + final signoff.

ops-bot: created ticket PROD-8427: "GA checklist — pilot->GA handoff" assigned to @Maya Li, due 3 days. <https://tickets.internal/PROD-8427> :white_check_mark:

Maya Li: thanks — please drop short commits in the ticket. we'll triage tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup:
